# Dewiride Invoice Generator

> A free invoice generator that runs entirely in the browser. Fill in a form,
> watch the live preview, download a PDF. No account, no upload, no server:
> invoices are built client-side and never leave the device.

Operated by Dewiride Technologies Private Limited (Jodhpur, Rajasthan, India).
The tool is free with no usage limit, no paid tier and no registration step.
There is nothing to sign up for and no invoice count to exhaust.

## What it does

- Builds a professional PDF invoice from a form, with a live preview that
  matches the PDF exactly.
- Supports 150+ currencies, formatted with the correct symbol, decimal places
  and digit grouping for each (JPY has no minor unit, KWD has three, en-IN
  groups as 1,23,456).
- Remembers businesses, clients and item descriptions in the browser for
  autocomplete, and lets the user inspect or delete all of it.
- Keeps the current draft across a page refresh.
- Works on mobile, in light and dark themes, and meets WCAG AA contrast.

## Privacy

No invoice content reaches a server. There is no backend that could receive
it. PDF generation happens in the browser. Anonymous, aggregate analytics
(page views, currency chosen, item count) are collected; invoice text,
names, addresses and amounts are not.

## Pages

- [Invoice generator](https://invoice.dewiride.com/): the tool itself.
- [About](https://invoice.dewiride.com/about/): who operates it, and contact details.

- [Terms of service](https://invoice.dewiride.com/terms/): terms of use.

## For automated agents

The page is built to be driven without CSS selectors. Every control has a
unique accessible name, and the form's completion state is exposed both as
visible text and as a `data-invoice-complete` attribute on an element with
`role="status"`, so an agent can tell "ready" from "half-filled" without
re-deriving the rule. Filling the labelled fields and activating the
"Download as PDF" button is the whole flow.
